items:
Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Welcome to "Serene Dunes!" This large, brand new, beautifully decorated 5 bedroom, 5 1/2 bath beach home is only minutes from the gorgeous waters of the Emerald coast, and boasts a private *heated pool, 5 outdoor seating areas, 2 living areas, and a free golf cart!



By reserving this property, you also receive a credit to be used toward beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita!



This home is located in Santa Rosa Beach on the west end of 30A in the popular family friendly neighborhood of, "Serenity at Dune Allen." The neighborhood is situated directly across from the brand new public beach access, which is equipped with plenty of parking, nice new bathrooms, and a large ramp all the way down to the sand. It is minutes from the popular shopping, and dining area of Gulf Place.



The open concept first floor of the home is a perfect place to hang with all the family, where everyone has room to spread out and still feel included. The well appointed kitchen offers beautiful quartz counter-tops, stainless appliances, a large farm style dining table with seating for up to 10 guests, and 5 additional seats at the expansive kitchen island! Off of the kitchen is a Master Suite, complete with a king bed and a large master bathroom, with double sinks, and a large walk-in shower. Off the first floor hallway is access to the home's private pool area. This patio has outdoor seating for 4, a bbq grill, and a perfect sized pool for cooling off after a hot day at the beach! Also on the first level of the home is a half bath off the hallway, and a laundry closet for use during your stay. .



The second floor boasts 3 additional bedrooms, as well as built-in full over full hallway bunks. On this level there are 2 guest suites, each featuring a king bed, full private bathrooms with a walk-in shower, and each with access to their own private balcony for your morning coffee, or evening night cap. Additionally there is a 3rd guest bedroom on this level with king bed, and a full hallway bathroom with dual sinks and a walk-in shower.



Moving up to the 3rd floor of the home you will find a large 2nd living area, bunk room, and the homes 5th full bathroom. Furnished with a comfortable sectional, large flat screen tv, and a game table, the kids are sure to enjoy making memories in this bonus living space. There is a bunk room off this loft area with 1 set of twin over twin bunks, 1 set of full over full bunks, and full bathroom with a tub/shower combo as well. Lastly you will find the homes 5th balcony off this 3rd story loft so everyone has space to spread out and enjoy the beautiful Florida weather!



During your stay at "Serene Dunes," you can enjoy spending your days on the white sandy beaches and Emerald Coast, lounging by the home's private pool, or should you choose to do so, walk to the neighborhood's large community pool right around the corner! Just one vacation in this fabulous home, and you'll know you have found your annual vacation destination for years to come!



SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16 guests. This does include the 3 sets of bunk beds, 2 sets in the 3rd floor bunk room and 1 set of full/full hallway bunks. 10 Beds in all)

Amenities:

- Free Six Seater Golf cart (requires proof of valid drivers license and insurance, as well as a signed golf cart waiver prior to use!)

- Comes with credit to use through La Dolce Vita

- Flat Screen TV's in all Bedrooms

BEACH ACCESS: Dune Allen Beach/ Ft. Panic





Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.







SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



FAQ's:

Type of coffee pot: K cup or standard coffee pot

Parking spots: 3 vehicles max plus LSV.

Distance to beach: 2-3 minute ride to the beach

Bikes included: No (can use rental credit through La Dolce Vita)

Beach Chair and Umbrella set-up included? No (Can use rental credit through La Dolce Vita)



Guests are responsible for any damage to or towing of golf carts during their stay. Misuse or negligence resulting in repair or replacement costs will be charged to the guest. Please operate carts safely and follow all guidelines. Use implies acceptance of these terms.



To ensure a comfortable experience for all guests, the primary renter must be 25 years of age or older. The guest who completes the booking is required to stay at the property for the entirety

description:
Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, is home to this vacation home. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
